title: MEGA: Message Passing Neural Networks for Multigraphs with EdGe Attributes
abstract: arXiv:2412.00241v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Edge-attributed multigraphs, in which multiple edges with distinct attributes connect the same pair of nodes, arise naturally in many real-world systems. In these graphs, effective learning requires preserving information from repeated interactions while distinguishing contributions from different neighbors. Existing neural network solutions for edge-attributed multigraphs remain limited: some lose information from repeated interactions, while others break permutation equivariance. To address this, we introduce \emph{neighbor-aware aggregation}, an operator that first combines multi-edge features for each neighbor and then aggregates across neighbors. This operator captures per-neighbor statistics that standard single-stage aggregation cannot represent. translated_title: MEGA：面向带边属性多重图的消息传递神经网络
translated_abstract: 带边属性的多重图（即多条具有不同属性的边连接同一对节点）在许多现实世界的系统中自然出现。在这类图中，有效的学习需要在保留重复交互信息的同时区分来自不同邻居的贡献。现有的针对带边属性多重图的神经网络解决方案仍然有限：一些方法会丢失重复交互中的信息，另一些方法则会破坏置换等变性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“邻居感知聚合”，这是一种先为每个邻居组合其多条边的特征、然后再跨邻居进行聚合的算子。该算子能够捕捉标准单阶段聚合无法表示的逐邻居统计信息。基于这一算子，我们提出了MEGA-GNN，一个面向带边属性多重图的、与具体模型无关的消息传递框架。我们证明了MEGA-GNN具有置换等变性，并且……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“邻居感知聚合”算子及MEGA-GNN消息传递框架，能够在保留多重图中重复交互信息的同时保持置换等变性，克服了现有方法丢失信息或破坏等变性的局限。
en_tdlr: MEGA introduces neighbor-aware aggregation and the MEGA-GNN framework, which preserves information from repeated interactions in edge-attributed multigraphs while maintaining permutation equivariance.
